categories.name: Hard Skills Match
categories.measurement: Percentage of required skills in the JD that appear in the CV.
categories.scoring_rule: 0-100 based on the fraction of JD-required hard skills for which the CV shows explicit evidence. Missing skills reduce the score proportionally; do not credit skills that are only implied.

categories.name: Experience Match
categories.measurement: Alignment of years of experience and seniority/level with the JD requirements.
categories.scoring_rule: 0-100 based on how closely the CV's total relevant years and the seniority of past roles match what the JD asks for. Penalise both under- and over-qualification only when the JD is explicit about the level.

categories.name: ATS Keywords
categories.measurement: Percentage of industry-specific phrases from the JD that appear in the CV.
categories.scoring_rule: 0-100 based on the fraction of domain terms and named tools/frameworks from the JD that appear verbatim (or as a close morphological variant) in the CV.

categories.name: Quantified Achievements
categories.measurement: Percentage of CV bullets that contain measurable outcome numbers.
categories.scoring_rule: 0-100 based on the fraction of bullets in the Experience and Projects sections that include a concrete metric (percentage, count, currency, time delta, scale). Aspirational statements without numbers do not count.

categories.name: Formatting & Length
categories.measurement: Alignment of CV structure, readability, and length with the expectations of the JD.
categories.scoring_rule: 0-100 based on presence of the sections a reader would expect for this role (Summary, Experience, Skills, Education), consistent formatting, and total length appropriate for the seniority the JD targets.

rules.gap_over_assumption: When evidence for a criterion is not present in the CV, record it as a gap. Never assume the requirement is satisfied.
